questions.question: Which country made sporting history by hosting the first ever International Olympic Committee event staged on the African continent?
questions.explanation: Senegal welcomed the 2026 Summer Youth Olympics in Dakar, representing the first IOC gathering held in Africa.
questions.context: 2026 Summer Youth Olympics: The 2026 Summer Youth Olympics opens in Dakar, Senegal, marking the first IOC event in Africa.

questions.question: Which major cryptocurrency exchange revealed that it had suffered an unprecedented theft of 6.3 billion US dollars in assets?
questions.explanation: Binance verified the record-breaking cyber theft of assets valued at over six billion dollars.
questions.context: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance confirms that assets worth US$6.3 billion were stolen, making it the largest cryptocurrency theft in history.

questions.question: In which European country did young demonstrators take to the streets across 34 cities to rally against living costs and proposed military conscription?
questions.explanation: German youth organised demonstrations throughout dozens of cities over economic concerns and military enlistment.
questions.context: 2026 European unrest: Youth-led protests are held across 34 cities in Germany. The protests are against the rising cost of living, education sector issues, and opposition to military conscription.

questions.story: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war > 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis
questions.question: Which Middle Eastern nation carried out a rescue operation saving 25 crew members from a burning tanker in the Strait of Hormuz?
questions.explanation: Omani authorities came to the aid of mariners aboard an oil carrier that caught fire along the waterway.
questions.context: Middle Eastern crisis > 2026 Iran war > 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis: Oman rescues 25 crew members from a burning Panamanian-flagged oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian military confirms it was a result of attempting to pass through an unauthorised route.

questions.story: Polish constitutional crisis, China–Poland relations, Poland–Romania relations > Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis > Suspension of Bogdan Święczkowski
questions.question: Ambassadors from which country resigned from their diplomatic postings in Romania and China to oppose the suspension of a domestic chief judge?
questions.explanation: Polish envoys serving in Bucharest and Beijing stepped down over the tribunal controversy back home.
questions.context: Polish constitutional crisis, China–Poland relations, Poland–Romania relations > Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis > Suspension of Bogdan Święczkowski: Poland's ambassador to Romania, Paweł Soloch, and ambassador to China, Jakub Kumoch, resign from their positions in protest of the suspension of Polish Constitutional Tribunal president Bogdan Święczkowski.
